title: Sunday Morning Apple Strudel
description: A classic German dessert, perfect for a relaxing Sunday morning. This strudel is filled with juicy apples, crunchy pastry, and a hint of citrus.
instructions: Roll out the pastry dough to a thickness of 1/8 inch.
In a large bowl, combine the sliced apples, citrus zest, and creme fraiche.
Place the apple mixture onto one half of the pastry dough, leaving a 1/2 inch border.
Fold the other half of the pastry dough over the filling, pressing the edges to seal.
Brush the top of the strudel with a little water and sprinkle with sugar.
Bake for 25-30 minutes, or until the pastry is golden brown.
Serve warm, dust with powdered sugar if desired.
